pricing._source: offline provider costs nothing; set real rates when switching provider/model

_notes: provider/model are config-driven, never hardcoded in code. 'offline' uses the built-in mock client and makes no network calls; switch to a real provider id plus its api_key_env and pricing to make billed runs. The API key is NEVER stored here - it is read from os.environ via the var named by 'api_key_env'.
